scripts.test: pnpm --filter electron-gpui --filter electron-gpui-unplugin test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.lint: pnpm build && vp check && cargo fmt -p electron-gpui -p electron-gpui-hotpatch -p counter-native -p counter-theme --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: vp fmt && cargo fmt -p electron-gpui -p electron-gpui-hotpatch -p counter-native -p counter-theme
